Subject: Weekly XFN sync — rollforward playbook & exec asks (QBR prep)

Team — attaching an updated QBR prep tracker and the open security exception log. Two things I want us to surface in today's follow-up: (1) a clear owner and deadline for every exec ask so the ELT can sign off ahead of the QBR, and (2) a rollout contingency for the Dedicated->Hosted fallback we flagged last week.

Quick asks: 
- Please update the tracker (tab: "Exec Asks") with owner + completion ETA by EOD today.
- Vivek: can you confirm the top three exceptions that need legal/infosec sign-off and whether customers need outreach?
- Marissa: list the canary plan items (metrics + rollback triggers) in the doc and attach the flattened checklist.
- Karthik/Jonas: confirm whether any roadmap asks require scope reduction to hit the QBR commitments.

I've attached: QBR_prep_tracker_v3.xlsx (master action list), security_exception_log_Q3.pdf (summary), and a short screenshot of the ELT slide we will preview. I'll run a 20-minute sync at 10:45 if folks want to join — otherwise we'll coordinate asynchronously here.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

- Customer comms for the Dedicated fallback (owner: marissa_cole) — recommend templated outreach for accounts larger than $50k/mo. Draft in Drive link below.

Open question: the ELT is asking for cost delta estimates on the Hosted fallback for two enterprise customers (Acme Retail and GammaAI). I looped in procurement/Acme contact below to confirm the contract implication — Sarah can you confirm whether we should propose a temporary addendum for capacity SLAs?

I'll join the quick sync at 10:45 to walk the canary checklist.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

- Streaming-prefetch: deliver MVP (basic cache priming + metrics) by 2027-10-05. Will reduce scope of enrichment and defer non-blocking observability work. I've updated the tracker with scope bullets and ETA.

All other items I own are reflected in the tracker. If the ELT wants a single slide summarizing what we pulled from the QBR, I'm happy to draft it — assigning to myself.
